attackers_goals: While probing the network, an attacker may discover dormant hosts. These inactive systems can then be used for lateral movement or privilege escalation.
description: The endpoint has performed multiple connections to an endpoint that is relatively inactive on the network.
investigative_actions: Validate that the source is not a sanctioned port scanner. Check for suspicious artifacts in the endpoint profile.
name: Abnormal connections to a dormant host from a newly seen endpoint
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
